headline: Small-craft advisory outer waters — stay inside, fish Saturday
body:
A small-craft advisory runs through late Friday night for the outer waters and the San Miguel/Santa Rosa zone, and the weekend looks no better: NW 25–35 kt with 8–11 ft seas out west and south Saturday night into Sunday. Inside the east channel it's civil — light morning winds, 3–5 ft, patchy morning fog, west 5–10 kt Saturday.

The long runs are off. Santa Rosa Flats has the only 64–68 °F water at 64.3 °F Saturday, but it's blowing 22–27 kt with 6–8 ft seas both days, so bluefin and the Flats rockfish patches are out; San Nicolas at 69.5 °F is 73 nm into the same NW blow, and Osborn isn't worth threading 8–11 ft seas for 71 °F water.

Saturday is your day. Run the backside of Santa Cruz early for yellowtail — 72.4 °F, 6 kn and 3.5 ft in the morning, with west wind and gusts to 19 building by late afternoon. Or work the Goleta–Carpinteria sand for halibut in 3.2 ft and near-glass at dawn. Sunday's morning is lighter still on the backside, but seas build behind it.
